Noticed a few issues:
- Modal title is missing
- Progress bar is appearing in the success toast
- On clicking delete/disconnect button, a dialogue is shown instead of a modal
- All buttons are unresponsive on Network page

> Modal title is missing
Can you be more specific?

> Progress bar is appearing in the success toast
The Default BootstrapVueNext behavior has changed.  Toasts include built-in progress bar support via the progress-props prop when using timed dismissal.  This can be disabled if we chose.

> On clicking delete/disconnect button, a dialogue is shown instead of a modal
This is mentioned in the commit message.
This was discussed here, in Discord, and in the Workgroup call.
$bvModal.msgBoxConfirm is not available in BootstrapVueNext and we need a replacement.  
Decision was to replace with Window.confirm for this PR and to follow up with a compatible replacement, which I have done here:   https://gerrit.openbmc.org/c/openbmc/webui-vue/+/84902

Can you be more specific?
On a few pages — for example, SNMP Alerts page, User Management page, and Certificates page — the modal title is missing when you click Add Destination/Add User/Add Certificate.

This can be disabled if we chose.

None of these are blocking anyway, we can also address these in a separate commit later

I see a couple of these.  Do we know why this was done?  Something prettier suggested?

Perhaps some tabs added by my IDE but I missed because of the previous comment disabling prettier.

Looking at the code, we're splitting a 64-bit size into high and low 32-bit values. The issue is that Prettier doesn't like the formatting of the exponentiation operator in this context.  Not that it really matters, but Math.floor() has traditionally be less performant.

I will replace with           
```view.setUint32(0, size >>> 32);```

This is cleaner, more performant, and allows us to remove the prettier comment.
This pairs nicely with the bitwise AND (& 0xffffffff) on the next line that extracts the low 32 bits.
Would've liked to see this done in its own commit with the above explanation as the commit message, but meh, lets just go ahead.
